title: Generic fibres of a cartesian family system
statement:
Let $I$ be a small cofiltered category, $S$ an integral scheme, and $C$ a scheme.
Let $X,Y:I\to\mathrm{Scheme}$, with $X_i$ integral quasi-compact quasi-separated and
all transitions of $X$ affine [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\alpha:S\to X$
and $\gamma:C\to Y$ be limiting cones, $c:C\to S$, and $p:Y\to X$ a natural
transformation whose components are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume every
$\alpha_i$ is dominant, every square $(c,\gamma_i,\alpha_i,p_i)$ is cartesian, and
for every arrow $f:i\to j$ the square $(Y(f),p_i,p_j,X(f))$ is cartesian
[def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$
form the generic-fibre pullback with $\iota:\operatorname{Spec}k(S)\to S$ and $c$.
Then there exist diagrams $D,K:I\to\mathrm{Scheme}$, limiting cones
$\kappa:C_\eta\to D$ and $b:\operatorname{Spec}k(S)\to K$, natural transformations
$r:D\to K$, $\delta:D\to Y$, $t:K\to X$, and isomorphisms
$e_i:K_i\cong\operatorname{Spec}k(X_i)$. Both $D$ and $K$ have qcqs objects and
affine transition maps. For every i the square $(r_i,\delta_i,t_i,p_i)$ is a pullback,
$e_i^{-1}t_i=\iota_i$, $\kappa_i r_i=q b_i$, $\kappa_i\delta_i=j\gamma_i$, and
$b_i t_i=\iota\alpha_i$, where $\iota_i$ is the generic point inclusion of $X_i$.

proof.text: Apply the dominant function-field limit theorem to X and its limit cone α, obtaining K, b, t, e and its qcqs and affine properties.

Take the actual pointwise pullbacks D_i=K_i×_{X_i}Y_i and combine their cones into a functor using PullbackCone.combine. The two projections give r and δ. Lift q b_i and j γ_i into the pullbacks; their compatibility follows from the original generic-fibre square and the comparison square at i. Pullback hom_ext and cone naturality prove that these lifts give the cone κ and both projection equations.

For any cone z over D, its composites with r and δ lift uniquely along b and γ. The resulting maps into Spec k(S) and C commute over S: test this with the limiting cone α and use each stage pullback square. Lift them into the supplied generic-fibre pullback Cη. The two projection equations prove the factorization equations at every stage. For uniqueness, test with q and j, then use the uniqueness of the lifts along b and γ. This is the explicit IsLimit construction in the Lean proof.

The projections D_i→K_i are base changes of the qcqs maps p_i, so their domains are qcqs. Paste the stage pullback square with the cartesian Y transition square, then cancel the stage pullback square at the destination. This proves that D(f) is the base change of K(f). Hence it is affine. Retain the constructed pullbacks and all projection equalities.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cartesian_family_generic_limit {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I]
    [IsCofiltered I] {S C : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral S]
    (X Y : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ i, IsIntegral (X.obj i)]
    (hXqc : ∀ i, CompactSpace (X.obj i)) (hXqs : ∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (X.obj i))
    (hXa : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (X.map f))
    (α : (Functor.const I).obj S ⟶ X) (γ : (Functor.const I).obj C ⟶ Y)
    (hα : IsLimit (Cone.mk S α)) (hγ : IsLimit (Cone.mk C γ))
    (c : C ⟶ S) (p : Y ⟶ X)
    (hpqc : ∀ i, QuasiCompact (p.app i)) (hpqs : ∀ i, QuasiSeparated (p.app i))
    (hdom : ∀ i, IsDominant (α.app i))
    (hcart : ∀ i, IsPullback c (γ.app i) (α.app i) (p.app i))
    (htrans : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      IsPullback (Y.map f) (p.app i) (p.app j) (X.map f))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c) :
    ∃ (D K : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (κ : (Functor.const I).obj Cη ⟶ D)
      (b : (Functor.const I).obj (Spec S.functionField) ⟶ K)
      (r : D ⟶ K) (δ : D ⟶ Y) (t : K ⟶ X)
      (e : ∀ i, K.obj i ≅ Spec (X.obj i).functionField)
      (_hκ : IsLimit (Cone.mk Cη κ)) (_hb : IsLimit (Cone.mk (Spec S.functionField) b)),
      (∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i)) ∧ (∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)) ∧
      (∀ i, CompactSpace (K.obj i)) ∧ (∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (K.obj i)) ∧
      (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)) ∧
      (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (K.map f)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsPullback (r.app i) (δ.app i) (t.app i) (p.app i)) ∧
      (∀ i, (e i).inv ≫ t.app i = (X.obj i).fromSpecStalk (genericPoint (X.obj i))) ∧
      (∀ i, κ.app i ≫ r.app i = q ≫ b.app i) ∧
      (∀ i, κ.app i ≫ δ.app i = j ≫ γ.app i) ∧
      (∀ i, b.app i ≫ t.app i = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ α.app i)
